headline: Public hearings on special permits and variances for properties on Pickett Ct., Oak St., Kernwood Ave., Virginia Ave., and Emily Way.
summary: The board will hear new requests for special permits and variances for home additions, garages, decks, and porches at several Beverly addresses. It will also review a modification to the City Hall addition design and continued hearings on a wireless facility and parking lot at 12 Tozer Road.
items: Stanley Greene o/b/o Anne Vallette requests a Special Permit to build a front porch and small dormer at garage for height at 10 Pickett Ct., Beverly MA
Conor F. Walsh, Esq. o/b/o Scott Bumpus & Debra Durso-Bumpus requests a Special Permit/Finding to construct multiple additions at 45 Oak St., Beverly MA
Jeremy Puz requests a Variance for side and rear setback requirements to convert the existing garage into a new Garage/ADU at 76 Kernwood Ave., Beverly MA
Ralph Rizzo requests a Variance to add a roof to existing front deck at 8 Virginia Ave., Beverly MA
Jason Brownstein requests a Special Permit to build a deck at 3 Emily Way, Beverly MA
Maria-Anna Hatziliades o/b/o City of Beverly requests a Modification to the addition design for City Hall at 191 Cabot Street
Cellco Partnership d/b/a Verizon Wireless and the Towers, LLC requests a Special Permit and height and setback Variances for a wireless communications facility at 12 Tozer Road
Conor F. Walsh, Esq. o/b/o 12 Tozer Self Storage Holdings LLC requests a Special Permit to authorize a parking lot and mixed use at 12 Tozer Road
location: Beverly Police Department Community Room, 175 Elliott Street, Beverly, MA
